name: n8_threshold
description: Near-threshold floor: long low-current pulses. DELIBERATELY BELOW the 9.1 envelope (200-250 mA fails the 50 um floor on this coil) and kept per 9.4 — the network should see non-response as a real machine state. Flagged by its own low stroke, never filtered here.
protocol: structured characterization block, repeated cycles per condition
